hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 singleton hook implementing a buyback-and-burn program: after every swap on a configured pool, it executes a reference-price-gated market buy of the pool's designated token (MAIN) using a secondary-token donation pot, delivering purchased tokens to a recipient (default burn via Glue Protocol). Optionally runs an auto-compounding LP program that harvests position fees and splits them across compound, burn, and recipient legs.
